About me

Hi, I'm O (Chanoknan), an engineer with over 3 years of hands-on experience in production, quality and design engineering.

My focus is improving factory workflows and reducing bottlenecks. I do this with real production trials and root-cause analysis. I also build AppSheet apps and Google Apps Script tools that automate daily data collection.

I use Power BI and Looker Studio to turn complex manufacturing records into clear dashboards that track KPIs and support management decisions. I also design and maintain SQL databases (Supabase and PostgreSQL) for real-time OEE data collection and machine-level monitoring. I'm now studying for an M.S. in Data Science.
